newsitem.title: GERMANY: Leica swings to 1996 H1 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Leica swings to 1996 H1 net profit.

text.p: Germany's prestige camera maker Leica Camera AG on Thursday said group net profit for the first half of 1996 swung to a profit of 1.9 million marks ($1.3 million) from a loss in the 1995 period despite a meagre gain in sales.
Leica, which issued shares to the public in September, said sales rose two percent to 98.5 million marks from 96.5 million marks in the year-ago period.

"The public share offering, the photokina trade fair and also the introduction of two new products made the first half of 1996 a extraordinary turbulent period," Leica management board chairman Klaus-Dieter Hofmann said in a statement.
Despite the weak consumer spending conditions in Germany and neighbouring countries, Hofmann said Leica still expected profits and strong sales growth in the second half of 1996.
